question_text: ON FIRE: STOP DROP & ROLL
Direct advice for overwhelming urges (review each)
answer:
Stop: No Important Decisions
Especially deciding to die. Do not panic. Ignore thoughts that you don't care if you die. Stop drugs and alcohol.
Physically step away from things that are a risk to you.

question_text: Direct advice for overwhelming urges (review each)
answer:
Drop: Shut It Down
Sleep (no overdosing). Can't sleep? Cold shower or face in ice-water (30 seconds and repeat). This is a reset button. It slows everything way down.

question_text: Direct advice for overwhelming urges (review each)
answer:
Roll: Find strong distractions.
Make Eye Contact if comfortable (a difficult but powerful pain reliever). Look in their eyes and say 'Can you help me get out of my head?'. Try video chat. Keep trying until you find someone.
